prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the complex functions and differential equations.

learning_outcomes.text: Getting knowledge about the basic description methods of automatic systems.
Getting knowledge about the basic analysis methods of automatic systems.
Getting knowledge about the basic synthesis methods of automatic systems.
The practical skills to build and run basic automation systems.
Skills to evaluate the performance of control systems.
Knowledge of basic methods for describing automation systems.
Knowledge of basic methods to analyze automation systems.
Knowledge of methods to synthesize automation systems.
Can define the mathematical description of the automation system.
Able to analyze the function of the automation system.
Can broaden their knowledge by using additional aids.
Can think and act in a creative way.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, basic terms, the structure of control systems and their classification.
Description of linear automation systems: differential equations, transfer function, time characteristics.
Description of linear automation systems: the frequency response, the frequency characteristics.
Stability. Theorem of stability, properties of stable and unstable systems.
Description of discrete systems. The differential equation, transfer function, frequency responce, time characteristics.
Automatic control. Requirements. Static control. astatic control.
Nonlinear systems. Methods of description and analysis.
Simulation tests of automatic objects in Matlab-Simulink system.
Mathematical fundamentals of digital automation systems.
Modeling and programming of sequential processes.
Modeling and programming of concurrent processes.
Modeling and programming of complex processes.
teaching_methods: Self study - self studies and preparation for examination
Self study - preparation for laboratory class
assessment_rules: The evaluation for the lecture component is based on an exam (F1). The evaluation for the laboratory component is based on the average grade (F1) for skills PEK_U01, PEK_U02, PEK_U03 and social competences PEK_K01, PEK_K02. Both are graded with credit.
